name: flow
description: Tracks a task through Matt Pocock's idea-to-ship flow, shows the next step above the prompt, and holds a build until its checks prove it.

autoAdvance.title: Auto-advance after approval
autoAdvance.description: After /flow approve, and when the model reports a build or closing stage finished (implement, implement-spec, diagnosing-bugs, pr), run the next stage at once instead of showing it. Planning never starts a build, gates still wait for you, and a full context stops it.

clearAt.title: Context nudge (%)
clearAt.description: From this share of the context window, the band and each gate suggest /clear before the next stage.

checks.title: Extra check commands
checks.description: Comma-separated text that marks a Bash command as a check the proof gate counts, beside the test, lint and typecheck runners it already knows: scripts/ci.sh, make smoke.

jevMode.title: Jev judgments
jevMode.description: off: never call Jev. shadow: Jev reads each prompt for rework and each build turn's end for evidence, and only logs (/flow jev). on: a rework prompt also carries a note for the model, and short evidence keeps the band from reading Ready. Sends clipped prompt and reply text to TypeSafe.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: The key Jev calls use. Empty reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

jevBaseUrl.title: Jev base URL
jevBaseUrl.description: Where /v1/systemone is served: TypeSafe's API, or a gateway that passes it through.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: Pinned on purpose: the thresholds were set against this version.
